description: Liste des aides à la navigation et de la signalisation routière is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Waterweg NV. List of navigation aids and road signs. Coverage: Vlaamse Waterweg NV. The portal shows the English title as "List of navigation aids and road signs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Waterweg NV. Its keywords include europees, binnenwatervervoer, vervoersnetwerken. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
